description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run to check the request's validity without actually exporting the image. Valid values:

- `true`: Performs a dry run. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned. If the check fails, an error is returned.
- `false`: Sends a normal request. If the check succeeds, the image is exported.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
镜像文件的导出格式。取值范围：
- raw。
- vhd。
- qcow2。
- vmdk。
- vdi。

默认值：raw。
description.en:
The format of the exported image file. Valid values:

- raw.

- vhd.

- qcow2.

- vmdk.

- vdi.

Default value: raw.
The ID of the custom image.
The destination OSS bucket for the exported image.

description.zh: 您的OSS  Object的前缀。可以由数字或者字母组成，字符长度为1~30。
description.en: The prefix for the OSS object. The prefix must be 1 to 30 characters in length and can consist of letters and digits.

description.zh: 自定义镜像的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the custom image. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh: 导出镜像时使用的RAM角色名称。
description.en: The name of the RAM role used to export the image.

title.zh: 导出一份自定义镜像到OSS

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs export-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --oss-bucket testexportImage --oss-prefix EcsExport --image-format raw --role-name AliyunECSImageExportDefaultRole --dry-run true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ExportImage --region cn-hangzhou --RoleName AliyunECSImageExportDefaultRole --ImageId 'm-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --DryRun true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --OSSBucket testexportImage --OSSPrefix EcsExport --ImageFormat raw
